context_rules:
RULES: Tool progression: wood→stone→iron→diamond pickaxe. Need pickaxe for stone/ore. Craft crafting_table from 4 planks before making tools. Diamond ore only spawns below y=16 — dig deep. Smelt raw_iron in furnace to get iron_ingot before crafting iron tools. If inventory full: !autoDiscard(5). Use !getCraftingPlan to check requirements before crafting.
COMMAND CHEAT SHEET — use ONLY these commands, never invent new ones:
- Mine/dig/collect ore or blocks: !collectBlocks("block_name", count)
- Dig downward staircase: !digDown(distance)
- Go back to surface: !goToSurface
- Find a specific block type: !searchForBlock("block_name", range)
- Craft an item: !craftRecipe("item_name", count)
- Check crafting plan: !getCraftingPlan("item_name", count)
- Smelt in furnace: !smeltItem("item_name", count)
- Give item to player: !givePlayer("player_name", "item_name", count)
- Equip item: !equip("item_name")
- Follow a player: !followPlayer("player_name", distance)
- Go to a player: !goToPlayer("player_name", distance)
- Go to coordinates: !goToCoordinates(x, y, z, distance)
- Place a block: !placeHere("block_name")
- Attack mob: !attack("mob_name")
- Check inventory: !inventory
- Check nearby: !nearbyBlocks
- Check stats/position: !stats
- Discard junk: !autoDiscard(count)
- Set a goal: !goal("description")
- Stop current action: !stop
- End goal: !endGoal
IMPORTANT: To mine ANY ore (diamond, iron, coal, lapis, redstone, gold, deepslate variants), ALWAYS use !collectBlocks. For example: !collectBlocks("deepslate_diamond_ore", 3)
